summary: Indian stock markets opened on a mixed note as gains in select banking stocks were countered by weakness in IT and Tata group shares. Rising US Treasury yields and declining global investor sentiment continue to act as headwinds for domestic equities. Meanwhile, active IPO participation and positive long-term bank profit projections provided underlying support.
